feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Federal immigration agent shoots and injures man in Austin, Texas
entry.summary: The person shot is in serious but stable condition, Austin Mayor Kirk Watson said in a press conference.

entry.title: Poison suspected in deaths of ten lions in game reserve in Tanzania
entry.summary: The lions were found dead inside the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a popular wildlife reserve in Tanzania. Deaths raise concerns over wildlife poisonings in East Africa.

entry.title: Germany's Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat
entry.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has faced a major electoral setback in two state elections, with his center-right party losing ground. The far-right Alternative for Germany party made significant gains.

entry.title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones
entry.summary: President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security. A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.

entry.title: PHOTOS: The precarious life of fisherfolk
entry.summary: In the bustling heart of the southern Indian city of Chennai is a market that never sleeps, where residents from the poorest neighborhoods wage a battle of survival with the sea.

entry.title: The capture of Western Yemen is making the country's humanitarian crisis worse
entry.summary: NPR speaks with people in Yemen and in aid groups who say the fighting is displacing families to areas without enough aid to support them.

entry.title: In New Orleans, an empty building becomes a free store — and roller skating rink
entry.summary: In the Lower Ninth Ward, an old Family Dollar stands covered in graffiti. It looks abandoned. But inside, it's a treasure trove — clothing, home goods, toys and books. And everything is free.

entry.title: Judge orders Fox to hand over hundreds of documents in shareholders' case
entry.summary: Fox Corp. must turn over hundreds of documents that could shed light on how founder Rupert Murdoch handled some of his media companies' biggest scandals.

entry.title: U.S. childcare costs are astronomical. More families are turning to grandparents
entry.summary: Grandparents taking care of their grandkids is nothing new. But the surging cost of childcare in the U.S. has made familial support even more critical for some parents who struggle to afford it.

entry.title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow
entry.summary: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.
